paper.abstract_en: The recently observed signatures of superconductivity proximate to a fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) state in a twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayer has revitalized interest in quantum phases of matter induced by anyon dynamics. Here we show how a panoply of anyon-driven phases associated with doping the lattice ${ν=2/3}$ FQAH state can be realized as competing instabilities of a Fermi surface of charge-$e/3$ ``quarks'' coupled to a $\mathrm{SU}(3)_{-1}$ Chern-Simons gauge field, which is dual to the more conventional $\mathrm{U}(1)_3$ Chern-Simons-Ginzburg-Landau theory of quasiholes. For example, a range of electronic superconductors emerge from \emph{color superconductivity}, under which the Fermi surface experiences a pairing instability mediated by gauge fluctuations. These include SC$\star$ phases -- where superconductivity coexists with topological order -- as well as topological superconductors displaying half-integer chiral central charges when the quarks are weakly paired. One example is a $p+ip$ ``color-valley-locked'' superconductor, a topological analogue of the color superconductor familiar in quantum chromodynamics. On the other hand, both superconducting and non-Fermi liquid phases can emerge when the quarks form an itinerant ferromagnet, polarizing the Fermi surface to a particular combination of colors. Finally, our framework naturally accommodates the possibility of anyonic bound state formation, allowing access to phases induced by doping anyons of charge $2e/3$ as opposed to $e/3$ within the same model. Our work unifies many earlier proposed anyonic phases as instabilities of a single parent \emph{quark metal} phase, distilling their emergence into a competition between superconductivity and itinerant color ferromagnetism.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文深入探讨了与凝聚态物理相关的任意子和拓扑相，使用了Chern-Simons理论和量子色动力学类比，展示了高度的理论深度和新颖性。它与全息凝聚态主题相关，并且代表了该领域的重大进展。
decision.title_zh: 任意子超导电性的着色
decision.abstract_zh: 最近在扭曲MoTe$_2$双层中观察到的邻近分数量子反常霍尔（FQAH）态的超导迹象，重新激发了人们对任意子动力学诱导的量子物质相的兴趣。在这里，我们展示了如何将掺杂晶格${ν=2/3}$ FQAH态相关的各种任意子驱动相实现为电荷-$e/3$“夸克”费米面与$\mathrm{SU}(3)_{-1}$ Chern-Simons规范场耦合的竞争不稳定性，该理论对偶于更常规的准空穴$\mathrm{U}(1)_3$ Chern-Simons-Ginzburg-Landau理论。例如，一系列电子超导体从\emph{颜色超导电性}中出现，在该超导电性下，费米面经历由规范涨落介导的配对不稳定性。这些包括SC$\star$相——其中超导电性与拓扑序共存——以及当夸克弱配对时显示半整数手征中心荷的拓扑超导体。一个例子是$p+ip$“颜色-谷锁定”超导体，它是量子色动力学中熟悉的颜色超导体的拓扑类似物。另一方面，当夸克形成巡游铁磁体时，超导和非费米液体相都可能出现，将费米面极化到特定的颜色组合。最后，我们的框架自然地容纳了任意子束缚态形成的可能性，允许在同一模型中访问掺杂电荷$2e/3$而非$e/3$的任意子所诱导的相。我们的工作将许多早期提出的任意子相统一为单一母体\emph{夸克金属}相的失稳，将其出现归结为超导电性和巡游颜色铁磁性之间的竞争。
